rationale: DFT scan is per-implementation, not protocol-level

extraction_strategy.ic_class_applicability_gate_v0_1_62: ic_class='serial_peripheral_protocol' declares LL20 not applicable; emitted as N/A stub (l_doc_taxonomy.na_stub)

fields.notes: CAN 2.0 does not specify DFT / scan / BIST. Protocol-level self-checking (CRC + bit monitoring + bit stuffing + frame check + ACK) plus fault confinement counts provide system-level diagnostics. SoC-integrated CAN controller IP from modern vendors (Bosch C_CAN / M_CAN, Microchip MCP2515, Xilinx XLN_CAN) adds standard scan insertion at the integrator level.
